result.instructions: Tools for SafetyChain, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which CAPAs are still open at our Dallas plant, and which are overdue?"; "Show the non-compliant records submitted in the last 7 days."; "List our enabled suppliers and the forms we use.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SafetyChain data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run safetychain_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run safetychain_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run safetychain_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. safetychain_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

is_deleted.description: Only deleted (true) or not deleted (false) rows.

limit.description: Return at most this many rows (default 200, max 1000); the reply says how many were cut.

tools.name: safetychain_search_capas
tools.title: Search CAPAs
tools.description: Search corrective and preventive actions (CAPA, SCAR, CCAR). Filters combine with AND. Returns id, name, severity, owner workgroup, status, event and due dates, task counts, location and template type, 50 per page. Use the Id (a GUID) with safetychain_get_capa and the other CAPA tools. POST /clientapis/capamanagement/v1.0/capas (a read: it only searches).

statuses.description: CAPA statuses, for example Draft, Open, Closed, Voided (up to 10).

tools.name: safetychain_search_records
tools.title: Search records
tools.description: Search submitted records (the headers: record number, compliance, submitted date, location, form and version, resource, who submitted, signed, verifications, ids). Filter by date range, form, location, resource, identifier and compliance. Always narrow by a date range or a name: the tenant can hold millions of records. Pages are not snapshotted: for a stable multi-page read use a closed date range (start and end in the past). Use safetychain_get_record_fields for the field values. POST /clientapis/v2.0/getRecords (a read: it only searches).

date_type.description: Which date the range applies to (default submitted). processed = when SafetyChain saved it; modified = last change (includes submitted when never modified); modifiedOnly = only records actually modified.

start.description: Start of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss. Not together with min_ago.

end.description: End of the date range (default: now).

min_ago.description: Sliding window: records from the last N minutes (1440 = a day). Not together with start.

time_zone_offset.description: Hours from UTC applied to the date filters and the dates returned (default 0).

form_like.description: Form name contains this text (slower than form_name).

resource_name.description: Exact resource name (customer, equipment, item or supplier).

identifier_name.description: Identifier field name, for example Lot. Use together with identifier_value.

identifier_value.description: Identifier value that goes with identifier_name.

is_signed.description: Only records with a sign-off or validation.

record_compliance.description: Only compliant (true) or non-compliant (false) records. Records without compliance rules count as compliant.

tools.name: safetychain_get_record_fields
tools.title: Get record field values
tools.description: Get the field-level values of records (one entry per record with its fields: name, short name, type, value, unit, compliance, min, max, target, comments, section). Same filters as safetychain_search_records; narrow strongly (a record number or one form and a short date range), each record carries many fields. POST /clientapis/v2.0/getRecordsWithFields (a read).
